messages:
joan: CI alert — structured-output evals failing for quantized variant q8x on job eng-ml-evals/struct-out-qa #528. Seems to be function-call JSON shape.

taylor: Can you paste the failing assertion and a small example from the logs?

joan: Sure. Root excerpt from runner log:

```
AssertionError: response.tool_call missing required property: args
Expected schema: {"type":"object", "properties":{"tool_call":{"type":"object", "required":["name","args"]}}}

Found: {"tool_call":{"name":"lookup_user"}}
```

rachel: Interesting — the model is returning a tool_call without args when there are no args. Previously we accepted missing args and treated it as {}.

leo: Could be serialization pruning of empty maps in the new quantized path. There was a recent rapidjson bump in the q8x runtime build (1.4.1 -> 1.4.3) and an int8 kernel change that touched the JSON writer.

eval-ci-bot: Job eng-ml-evals/struct-out-qa #528 failed at 2025-11-03T09:03:12Z. Logs: /ci/logs/528

joan: I reproduced locally with the small runner dataset. It's reproducible and consistent.

taylor: Short-term fix: relax the schema validation in the harness to accept missing args and coerce to {} with a log event. Long-term: fix the runtime serializer.

rachel: Agreed. I'll open a small MR that changes the JSONSchema for tool_call to make args optional and records a metric tag schema_field=args when it's missing. Draft PR: #2012.

leo: I'll try pinning rapidjson to 1.4.1 in a runtime patch and run the q8x tests. If pinning avoids pruning empty objects, we'll know it's the lib change.

joan: Also adding a unit in the runner that simulates the quantized decoder path writing empty maps to ensure they don't get omitted.

taylor: Dashboard note: our Grafana panel was only querying run_type:stable and missed exp/q8x runs, so the spike looked invisible. We should widen the query and add run_type and model_variant breakdowns.

rachel: For metrics, propose new metric name: func_call_schema_violations (tags: job, model_variant, schema_field). Alerting: >3 violations in 5m for any single model_variant.

eval-ci-bot: Triggered job eng-ml-evals/struct-out-qa #529 for branch schema-relax (joan).

leo: Pinning rapidjson and rerunning CI now.

infra-bot: Notified infra team — building pinned runtime artifact may take ~20m.

joan: If CI passes with the harness change + pin, we'll ship the harness patch to keep experiments green and follow up with a runtime fix. I'll link PRs and the reproducible test here.

taylor: Also add an onboarding note: when bringing new quantized variants, run the serializer regression test and include a small sample of function-call outputs in the model bundle.

rachel: Sounds good. I'll update eval-runner docs and add the metric def to metrics/eng-ml-evals.yml in the same MR.

leo: If pinning doesn't help, I'll bisect the runtime changeset and open a revert for the serializer patch.

joan: OK team — thanks. I'll post CI links once #529 finishes. :thumbsup:
